forest.title: Forest
forest.author: Joseph SARDIN
forest.description: Realistic forest ambience recorded outdoors in calm weather. The soundscape is filled with varied birdsong, occasional wing flutters and the soft buzz of passing insects. In the far background, a faint hint of distant traffic can be heard, adding a touch of realism without masking the natural environment. This gentle and lively nature bed works very well for video editing, radio, games, apps, or as a soothing background for relaxation and focus.

stream.title: Forest and Stream #1
stream.author: Joseph SARDIN
stream.description: Small brook, blackbird, fly, birds, 2 different sounds of the brook (on the left, a deeper "meander" and on the right another shallower one, so I put myself in the middle!). Forest of Signy-l'Abbaye (Ardennes).

night.title: Campaign at Night #4
night.author: Joseph SARDIN
night.description: Country soundscape in the evening, in a meadow. Field crickets, rare frogs. Recorded on May 5, 2020 around 10 p.m., in France.

insects.title: Nocturnal insect #2
insects.author: Joseph SARDIN
insects.description: Song of a field cricket. Same insect as sound 426. Recorded very close, about 10 cm. The high-pitched sound is accompanied by a lower, more “mechanical” noise.

sea.title: Sea Waves with Tern Calls
sea.author: Joseph SARDIN
sea.description: Medium sea waves lap the shore while Sandwich terns call overhead, creating a realistic seaside ambience with a soft, distant ocean roar. This free, royalty-free sea waves and seagulls sound effect is ideal as background audio for films, YouTube videos, games, podcasts, meditation apps, sleep or study playlists. Clean recording with no voices or music, easy to loop or mix into your own soundscapes. Thanks to Renaud LR for identifying the terns.

calmsea.title: Small Waves Facing the Ocean
calmsea.author: Joseph SARDIN
calmsea.description: Small waves in English Channel recorded facing the sea on the beach of Houlgate, Calvados, Normandy, France.

city.title: Aubervilliers Street
city.author: Joseph SARDIN
city.description: Atmosphere at a crossroads in Aubervilliers, near Paris.

citynight.title: Paris by Night
citynight.author: Joseph SARDIN
citynight.description: Soundscape taken at 1 am in Paris at the second floor balcony of an apartment. Place Saint Augustin.

wind.title: Wind
wind.author: Joseph SARDIN
wind.description: Wind noise, made with a technique Foley: https://www.libertivi.com/lelabodubruiteur_122

room.title: Sound Atmosphere in a House
room.author: Joseph SARDIN
room.description: Sound atmosphere in a house. This is an atmosphere to be put very low.

plane.title: Airplane, Pass #5
plane.author: Joseph SARDIN
plane.description: Sound design of a plane with engine and propeller, passing by.

rain.title: Summer Rain on Terrace
rain.author: Joseph SARDIN
rain.description: Big drops of summer storm on a terrace.

fire.title: Fireplace #5
fire.author: Joseph SARDIN
fire.description: Fireplace. To learn how to make the sound effects of a fire https://www.libertivi.com/lelabodubruiteur_113

static.title: Crackling Radio #2
static.author: Joseph SARDIN
static.description: Crackling by radio. When switching from one radio channel to another.

boat.title: Boat - Back deck
boat.author: Joseph SARDIN
boat.description: Back deck of a boat. This is the ferry between Royan and the Pointe de Grave. Near Bordeaux, France.

bus.title: London bus
bus.author: Joseph SARDIN
bus.description: Soundscape. First floor of a double-decker bus Londoner.

heli.title: Helicopter #1
heli.author: Joseph SARDIN
heli.description: Noise of a helicopter. Recording from inside. Wind noise in the paddles. Low and muffled. Sound is difficult loopable.

door.title: Door Slamming #4
door.author: Joseph SARDIN
door.description: Interior door slamming with a draft.

splash.title: Splash, Big #1
splash.author: Joseph SARDIN
splash.description: Big "splash" of a big stone thrown in a big water tank.

anvil.title: Anvil #2
anvil.author: Joseph SARDIN
anvil.description: Sound of a hammer striking an anvil repeatedly as a blacksmith works the iron. Sound recording using a microphone with a cardioid capsule.

bonk.title: Block "Meinl" in wood
bonk.author: Joseph SARDIN
bonk.description: Multiple hits on a Meinl wood block.

boing.title: Boing Cartoon #2
boing.author: Joseph SARDIN
boing.description: Sound of a harp imitating the bounce in a cartoon.

whistle.title: Ghost on the Flute #1
whistle.author: Joseph SARDIN
whistle.description: Cry of a ghost made with a slide (or piston) flute. Hooouuuu!

scratch.title: Vinyl Scratch #18
scratch.author: Joseph SARDIN
scratch.description: A little scratch on a vinyl record.

whoosh.title: Whoosh #4
whoosh.author: Joseph SARDIN
whoosh.description: Whoosh made with a long rope.

blow.title: Blow hard #1
blow.author: Joseph SARDIN
blow.description: A man is blowing hard. A candle for example.

pencil.title: Pencil, signature #2
pencil.author: Joseph SARDIN
pencil.description: I sign with a pencil on a sheet of paper.

magic.title: Chimes "Dream" #1
magic.author: Joseph SARDIN
magic.description: Cluster chimes of a dream hook.

dmochas.author: dmochas
